driverFormulas.rev: Total Revenue = Gross Revenue − Agency Discounts
driverFormulas.cogs: Programme & Production Costs = Acquired + Commissioned + Studio Production
driverFormulas.gp: Contribution after Programme Costs = Total Revenue − Programme & Production Costs
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Contribution Margin % = Contribution / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Costs = Payroll + Contractors + Other Opex
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Studios & Equipment + Buildings + IT
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: COP Margin % = COP / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Net Financial Items = Finance Income − Finance Costs + Other
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit Before Tax = COP + Net Financial Items
driverFormulas.ni: Net Income = Profit Before Tax − Income Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = Net Income / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Inventory + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Programme Rights Inventory = Rights + WIP + Ready
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = PP&E + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Debt + Deferred Revenue
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = Debt + Deferred Tax + Provisions
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + Other Reserves
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Net Income + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Leases + Dividends
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
